svg.title: Proposed Brown–Orange through-route map
svg.desc: Unofficial schematic in the style of a transit map. Brown and Orange run together from Kimball through Merchandise Mart, down Wells, along Van Buren, then to Roosevelt and Midway. Green stays on Lake and Wabash. Pink and Purple Express still circle the Loop. Red (State St) and Blue (Dearborn St) subways run through the Loop.
